notes: Each row represents a distinct USDA food code. The numeric code in START is used as the unique concept_code. The descriptive text in LABEL becomes the concept_name. The FMTNAME column indicates the format used in the NHANES dataset and is not needed for the concept definition, so it is omitted. The vocabulary is a new local vocabulary named NHANES_USDA_FOOD, and the concept_class_id is set to "USDA Food Code" to reflect the source. Domain is set to "Food" to match OMOP domain for food items.
